name: KAFKA Operator
description: Typed GitHub operations, per-write approvals, evidence revision, and optional cheap-task model routing.

github.tokenEnv.label: GitHub token environment variable
github.tokenEnv.help: Environment variable holding the GitHub token. The token itself is never stored in OpenClaw config.

github.allowedOwners.label: Allowed GitHub owners
github.allowedOwners.help: Writes fail closed unless the repository owner is listed here.

evidence.agentIds.label: Evidence-gated agents
evidence.agentIds.help: Agent ids whose material factual answers are revised once when no direct HTTPS source is present.

routing.provider.label: Cheap-task provider
routing.provider.help: Provider used for cheap deterministic tasks when routing is enabled.

routing.model.label: Cheap-task model
routing.model.help: Exact model id used with the cheap-task provider.
